transcript.text: Clearing out a drawer I found a letter from 2020 saying my Hotpoint washing machine might be part of a fire safety recall. Model WMXTF 742P UK. It's been working fine all this time - do I really need to do anything?
What is the main thing the washing machine is doing wrong?
Nothing's actually wrong with it, it works normally. The door area does get a bit warm on a 60 wash, but I assumed that was normal. It's the recall letter that's worrying me.
No problem — let's take it one step at a time. When you start a programme, what happens that shouldn't, or what doesn't happen that should?

Honestly nothing goes wrong, it washes and spins fine and there are no error codes. The machine's in the kitchen and I often run it overnight or when I'm out, which is partly why the letter worries me. What should I do about the recall?
What is the main thing the washing machine is doing wrong?
Sorry, I think we're going round in circles - nothing is wrong with the machine itself. I just want to know what to do about the recall letter. Can you tell me how to check if mine is affected?
No problem — let's take it one step at a time. When you start a programme, what happens that shouldn't, or what doesn't happen that should?
